title: U.S. Navy Demonstrates USV Refueling At Sea Using Robotic Towed Connector
summary: The U.S. Navy's Naval Air Warfare Center Weapons Division (NAWCWD) has successfully demonstrated at-sea refueling of an Unmanned Surface Vessel (USV) using a Robotic Towed Connector. This achievement significantly advances the operational endurance and capabilities of autonomous surface vessels.

title: US Navy Certifies Rolls-Royce mtu Engines for Autonomous Ships
summary: Rolls-Royce's MTU Series 4000 and Series 2000 marine engines have received certification from the U.S. Navy for use in autonomous naval vessel operations. title: SubSea Craft Unveils Modular Payload Cassettes for MARS USV
